visual_verdict.observed: Sixteen distinct poses in the requested order on white. Hook now includes a narrow reopening slit followed by a wider aperture. Chevron arms articulate gradually, preserve horizontal span and meet in a single shallow lid instead of switching into a smile arc. No extra drawings or obvious edge flecks.
visual_verdict.limitations: Generated rest and settled drawings are not pixel-identical; use the rest cel again for the settled playback beat to prevent loop drift. Slight variation in stroke weight and registration remains and requires the atlas's shared alignment, not separate per-frame stretching.
visual_verdict.recommended_playback: One shared translation/scale per family. Keep lower-lid baseline registered across all eight cells. Use rest at settle for a stable loop.
